title: Horizon Charity Drive 2027
resources: Faculty mentors, printed material and refreshments

claims.claim_text: We expect approximately 135 attendees for this Charity Drive, in line with turnout at our previous Charity Drive events.
The requested budget of INR 14,000 is realistic and sufficient for this Charity Drive.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
